claims.quote: Type locality appears to be the Mekong River north of Kratié town, Kratié province, eastern Cambodia, but the species is currently accepted to range throughout the Mekong drainage in Laos, Cambodia, southern Vietnam, and Thailand.

regions.name: Tonlé Sap
regions.quote: In the Tonlé Sap lake and river system, central Cambodia it's been recorded alongside a number of other fish species including Hampala macrolepidota, Osteochilus vittatus, Parachela siamensis, Puntius brevis, P. orphoides, Rasbora aurotaenia, R. paviana, R. rubrodorsalis, Yasuhikotakia modesta, Nemacheilus pallidus, Mystus bocourti, M. multiradiatus, Macrognathus semiocellatus, M. siamensis, Chanda siamensis, Pristolepis fasciata, Anabas testudineus, Trichopodus microlepis, Trichopsis schalleri, and Monotrete cochinchinensis.
